descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT 3.9; UAT 3.5 · “the model used for pre-round processing”. Mixed: stated part — every call logs model, durationMs and providerMs; calls over 30 s listed; our part — 12-drug volume and 'every pre-round drug is a row' (D4 open) (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Decision D4 · S0 · Vikram

Extraction rules vs UAT: should conditional and monitoring orders create tasks (UAT and TFA-92592 AC3 say yes, the prompt excludes them); should 'continue X' create a tracker row; the ported prompt lost 'continue X is a status, not a task'; Nursing Home dictation uses the Hospital vocabulary hint (the conditional / monitoring-order part is now answered by TFA-92592 AC 3 and fails on 43c38a4f: candidate N22; left here: 'continue X' tracker rows and the Nursing Home vocabulary hint)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-23/S23

Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S20 Medication-heavy dictation: time and model per call, and no dictated change dropped (12 drugs, 4 changes, both modes)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U21 Each run records which model did the pre-round processing and the medication-event extraction (and the speech-to-text engine for dictation), and logs the AI call's own time separately from the total. (UAT 3.1; UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9)
  • U18 The step mix (starts, holds, stops, dose changes, conditional orders, one-time doses) is dictated across two days and passes in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-19 Steps; UAT 3.3)
  • T9 No dictated medication or medication change is silently dropped, including in a long dictation with many drugs and several changes. (TFA-94229 R9 (Principle 2); UAT TC-19 (the tracker shows the medications the physician dictated); TFA-92597 What (keep the tracker current))
  • U7 A dose change renames the row to the new dose and keeps its history (the old dose stays readable on the row). (UAT TC-19 ER 4; TFA-92597 R7)
  • U11 'Gave one-time X' → a single-dose row shown as Given that expires; the standing order of the same drug is untouched. (UAT TC-19 ER 8; TFA-92597 R2)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given The S09 and S10 fixtures plus one long pre-round dictation per mode

When Run each pre-round fixture through ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes and each encounter fixture through ai/parsing:extractMedicationEvents; read diagnostics:list after the batch

Then Every call has an aiCallLog row with model, durationMs and providerMs (and fellBackFrom when Mistral answered); pre-round calls over 15 s and any call over 30 s are listed for review. In P-H and P-N every dictated drug is a row (13 each) and every change lands: apixaban held for hemoglobin, furosemide renamed to 20 with 40 kept, pantoprazole stopped, magnes …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): T9 (Pass/Fail per fixture): P-H and P-N's rowCount 13 and the four changes each. Deterministic: one log row per call with model + durationMs + providerMs (3.9, 3.5 'logs how long the AI call itself took'). Timing is a flag, never a Fail (3.5: targets, not pass/fail): pre-round over 15 s and any call over 30 s are listed for review (flagOverMs); …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (blocked)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Vikram.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Vikram) · environment dev · tickets TFA-92597 ready for qa; TFA-94229 in progress

From a 12-drug pre-round dictation, only the 4 drugs with a change get tracker rows. 'Continue' meds such as metoprolol and atorvastatin appear only in the Background summary.

Evidence: Allure 5b9a05b0. Ledger #62 U62: 'needs Vikram/golden set'. Dev report §3 row 4: should a never-seen 'continue X' create an active row? Rest tier because TFA-94229 is in progress.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.
